published_failure_contract: The 3.3.0 harness rejects the Maven 3.2.3 library present on the project test classpath with the assertion that Maven 3.2.4 or better is required.

source_isolation.evidence: The commit adds the exact published assertion and reads the maven-core version from its pom.properties resource in the test JVM.

a1_input.evidence: The public workbook records the directory, module, dependency versions and failing test, but no Git revision. The remote head still declares harness 3.2.0 and Maven libraries 3.2.3; it is evidence of the dependency shape, not proof of the executed revision.

target_history.evidence: No commit reachable from any remote ref declares harness 3.3.0 or upgrades the pinned Maven plugin API and compatibility libraries from 3.2.3 to 3.2.4 or later. Maintenance continued until 2016 without adopting the breaking input.

repair_boundary: Changing only the external Maven executable is not an established repair. The failing gate inspects maven-core on the test JVM classpath, so a valid target A2 would have to demonstrate a compatible project dependency graph while retaining harness 3.3.0.
stop_reason: The target revision is not fixed and the complete maintainer history has no A2 under harness 3.3.0. Rewriting the POM or CI environment would be a dataset-author repair.
